item.title: Maldives' Muizzu asks UK PM Burnham to reopen talks over Chagos Islands sovereignty
item.description: Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu has written to British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, asking him to reopen talks over the sovereignty of the Chagos Islands, a spokesperson said on Tuesday in a statement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu has written to British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, asking him to reopen talks over the sovereignty of the Chagos Islands, a spokesperson said on Tuesday in a statement. The spokesperson said Muizzu was "deeply disappointed" that Britain did not consult the Maldives when British Prime Minister Keir Starmer agreed to cede sovereignty of the Indian Ocean archipelago to Mauritius. A spokesperson for Britain's foreign office said in a statement: "We continue to speak to our counterparts in the Maldives on a regular basis about a range of issues. "However, the question of sovereignty over the Chagos Archipelago is a matter for the UK and Mauritius, which is why the previous government launched negotiations with Mauritius on the issue in 2022, rather than with the Maldives."

item.title: BlackRock mantiene su previsión alcista para la deuda de los mercados emergentes
item.description: BlackRock se mantiene firme en su perspectiva alcista para la deuda de los mercados emergentes, a pesar de que la rentabilidad está por debajo de sus previsiones, y apuesta por que el alivio de las preocupaciones sobre el dólar y la Reserva Federal contribuirá a una recuperación en los últimos meses de 2026.
item.dc:creator: Karin Strohecker
item.content:encoded: BlackRock se mantiene firme en su perspectiva alcista para la deuda de los mercados emergentes, a pesar de que la rentabilidad está por debajo de sus previsiones, y apuesta por que el alivio de las preocupaciones sobre el dólar y la Reserva Federal contribuirá a una recuperación en los últimos meses de 2026. La mayor gestora de activos del mundo pronosticó a principios de 2026 que los bonos en moneda fuerte emitidos por las economías de mercados emergentes registrarían rentabilidades totales en porcentaje de entre un dígito medio y alto, y que la deuda local obtendría rentabilidades de entre un dígito alto y dos dígitos bajos. Si bien esas previsiones aún no se han materializado, Michel Aubenas, responsable de deuda de mercados emergentes en BlackRock, espera que esta clase de activos recupere terreno a medida que una mayor claridad sobre la trayectoria de la política de la Reserva Federal reavive la demanda de activos de mayor rendimiento. "Entramos en los últimos cuatro meses del año con un mercado que sigue mostrándose bastante escéptico y nervioso respecto a las perspectivas de la Fed", dijo Aubenas. Los mercados emergentes se han enfrentado a un dólar resistente, un yen históricamente débil y unos altos precios del petróleo, lo que ha lastrado a muchas divisas asiáticas, señaló. "Una vez que empecemos a disipar algunos de estos factores macroeconómicos de carácter descendente, podremos volver a la tendencia anterior de una moderada debilidad del dólar, lo que favorecerá la rentabilidad", comentó. Los índices de JPMorgan muestran que la deuda en moneda local de los mercados emergentes ha rentado un 3,5% en lo que va de año, mientras que la deuda en moneda fuerte ha obtenido un rendimiento del 2,3%. Aubenas dijo que sigue siendo optimista respecto a toda la clase de activos, en particular la deuda en moneda local, citando los fundamentos económicos favorables y los flujos de inversión hacia las economías emergentes. "Espero que, durante el resto del año, veamos cómo la rentabilidad total se pone al día con nuestro escenario inicial", agregó Aubenas. Los costos de financiación se han disparado desde Washington hasta Tokio, ya que los inversores descuentan el impacto inflacionista del aumento de los precios de la energía y los crecientes déficits fiscales, lo que alimenta las expectativas de que las tasas de interés se mantendrán altas. Aubenas argumentó que la deuda de grado de inversión de los mercados emergentes de más largo plazo se había comportado mejor que los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos durante la reciente caída del mercado de bonos.

item.content:encoded: Sachsen-Anhalts Regierung verzichtet darauf, am 1. Oktober turnusgemäß den Vorsitz der Ministerpräsidentenkonferenz (MPK) zu übernehmen. In einem Schreiben an den derzeitigen Vorsitzenden Gordon Schnieder, Ministerpräsident von Rheinland-Pfalz, begründet Sachsen-Anhalts Landeschef Sven Schulze (CDU) dies mit der unsicheren Regierungsbildung in Magdeburg. Die Übernahme der Verantwortung für die Koordinierung zwischen den Ländern sei deshalb "nicht mehr sachgerecht". "Insbesondere ist unter diesen Rahmenbedingungen eine einwandfreie technische und inhaltliche Vorbereitung und Durchführung der Jahres-MPK nicht gewährleistet", schrieb Schulze in dem Reuters vorliegenden Brief weiter. Er bitte Rheinland-Pfalz, sich mit dem MPK-Co-Vorsitz Niedersachsen abzustimmen und einen Vorschlag für das weitere Verfahren zu machen. Bereits vor der Landtagswahl am Sonntag war im Länderkreis besprochen worden, ob man einen AfD-Ministerpräsidenten Ulrich Siegmund als MPK-Vorsitzenden verhindern könne. Hintergrund ist die Sorge, dass Siegmund das Gremium zur Bühne einer rechtsnationalistischen Politik machen könnte, hieß es. Die AfD hatte bei den Wahlen nur knapp die absolute Mehrheit verpasst. Die CDU hatte dagegen eine bittere Niederlage eingefahren. In Magdeburg gilt die Bildung einer neuen Regierung als unsicher. Die AfD braucht einen Koalitionspartner. CDU, SPD, Grüne und Linke lehnen die Zusammenarbeit mit der in dem Bundesland als gesichert rechtsextrem eingestuften Partei ab. Das BSW wiederum will keinen AfD- und keinen CDU-Ministerpräsidenten wählen, hat aber angedeutet, eine AfD-Minderheitsregierung in einzelnen Punkten unterstützen zu wollen. Siegmund selbst sagte aber, er wolle nur zu einer Ministerpräsidentenwahl antreten, wenn er eine stabile Mehrheit habe. Solange bleibt der amtierende Ministerpräsident Schulze geschäftsführend im Amt. Auch die "Rheinische Post" hatte über den Brief berichtet.

item.title: Ex-Fox legal head Dinh joins law firm Sullivan & Cromwell
item.description: Former top Fox Corp lawyer Viet Dinh is joining Sullivan & Cromwell, the Wall Street law firm said on Tuesday, three years after Dinh departed Fox in the wake of its $787.5 million settlement with Dominion Voting Systems.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: Former top Fox Corp (FOXA.O) lawyer Viet Dinh is joining Sullivan & Cromwell, the Wall Street law firm said on Tuesday, three years after Dinh departed Fox in the wake of its [USN:L1N36K27J TEXT:"$787.5 million settlement"] with Dominion Voting Systems. Sullivan & Cromwell co-chairs Robert Giuffra and Scott Miller said in a statement that Dinh would assist the firm's clients in their "most consequential strategic, transactional and crisis-management matters.” Dinh was the chief legal and policy officer at Fox and part of its senior management team when it agreed in April 2023 to settle Dominion's claims that it was defamed by false vote-rigging claims that were aired by the news outlet known for its roster of conservative commentators. Dinh [USN:L4N39S3M2 TEXT:"left Fox"] at the end of 2023 but continued to advise its leadership, Sullivan & Cromwell said. He will be a partner in the firm's Los Angeles office. In a statement released by Sullivan & Cromwell, Dinh said he looked forward to working on "transformational transactions and bet-the-company litigations and investigations for our clients.” Dinh was a former U.S. attorney general under President George W Bush and an architect of the Patriot Act, the U.S. national security law enacted after the Sept. 11, 2001 terrorist attacks. He was a founding partner of the Washington, D.C.-based litigation firm Bancroft PLLC, known for work on behalf of right-wing political causes, and was a partner at Kirkland & Ellis after it absorbed Bancroft in 2016. Dinh joined Fox in 2018. He received a lump-sum cash payment of $23 million as part of his separation agreement with the company. Since leaving the company, he became a principal at Palanquin Advisors, a venture capital firm, and sits on the board of directors of GrubHub parent Wonder and Irish building materials maker Kingspan Group, according to his LinkedIn profile. A Sullivan & Cromwell spokesperson said Dinh will wind down Palanquin Advisors and transition his clients to the firm. Lawyers at Sullivan & Cromwell are defending Republican President Donald Trump against charges that he falsified business records to cover up a $130,000 payment his former personal lawyer made to adult film actor Stormy Daniels for her silence before the 2016 presidential election about a sexual encounter she said she had with Trump years earlier. Trump [USN:L2N3OP0WX TEXT:"has appealed"] his May 2024 conviction. The firm is [USN:L1N3WI0ZL TEXT:"also representing Trump"] in his appeal to the New York Court of Appeals in the civil fraud case brought by Democratic New York Attorney General Letitia James. A state appeals court last year preserved the case while tossing a half-billion-dollar penalty a judge had entered.

item.title: Bank of America sube previsión precio Brent para segundo semestre de 2026 a 83 dólares por barril
item.description: Bank of America elevó este martes su previsión del precio del Brent a 83 dólares por barril para la segunda mitad del año, citando las continuas interrupciones en el estrecho de Ormuz.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of America elevó este martes su previsión del precio del Brent a 83 dólares por barril para la segunda mitad del año, citando las continuas interrupciones en el estrecho de Ormuz. Asimismo, elevó su previsión para el Brent a 75 dólares por barril para 2027. El banco prevé que el petróleo Brent cotice en un rango de entre 95 y 120 dólares por barril si los enfrentamientos que limitan el flujo de petróleo continúan hasta finales de año, y estima que los precios alcanzarán los 150 dólares por barril en caso de que se produzca un conflicto más amplio que provoque daños importantes en las infraestructuras energéticas.

item.content:encoded: Eine technische Störung bei der britischen Flugsicherung NATS hat zu Behinderungen an mehreren großen Flughäfen in Großbritannien geführt. Betroffen von Verspätungen und Einschränkungen waren am Dienstag unter anderem die Flughäfen London-Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted und Manchester. Zudem kam es am Flughafen der irischen Hauptstadt Dublin zu Verzögerungen. Das Problem liege im Flugdaten-Verarbeitungssystem, teilte NATS mit. Ingenieure arbeiteten an einer raschen Behebung des Fehlers. Der Luftraum bleibe geöffnet und es fänden weiterhin Starts statt, eine vollständige Normalisierung werde jedoch Zeit benötigen. British Airways sprach von einigen Flugstörungen in diesem Zusammenhang. In der Vergangenheit hatte es in Großbritannien wiederholt Probleme mit der Flugsicherung gegeben. Im Juli vergangenen Jahres führte ein Radarausfall dazu, dass der Flugbetrieb an mehreren Flughäfen für mehr als vier Stunden unterbrochen werden musste. Im Jahr 2023 hatte eine Fehlfunktion bei der automatischen Verarbeitung von Flugplänen ein Chaos im britischen Luftraum ausgelöst. Die britische Luftfahrtbehörde forderte NATS daraufhin im Jahr 2024 auf, die Notfallpläne zu überarbeiten. Den Fluggesellschaften entstanden durch den damaligen Vorfall Kosten von mehr als 100 Millionen Pfund für Entschädigungen und Rückerstattungen.

item.title: Director Alex Gibney dice el miedo ensombreció la realización del documental sobre Musk
item.description: Mucha gente tenía demasiado miedo como para hablar públicamente sobre Elon Musk, dijo el martes el director Alex Gibney, al presentar su largometraje documental sobre el empresario multimillonario en el Festival de Cine de Venecia.
item.dc:creator: Crispian Balmer
item.content:encoded: Mucha gente tenía demasiado miedo como para hablar públicamente sobre Elon Musk, dijo el martes el director Alex Gibney, al presentar su largometraje documental sobre el empresario multimillonario en el Festival de Cine de Venecia. La película, de casi cuatro horas de duración, narra el ascenso de Musk desde la era de las puntocom hasta convertirse en una de las figuras más influyentes del mundo, y se pregunta cómo un magnate tecnológico no elegido llegó a ejercer tal influencia sobre la política y el debate público. "Había un tremendo miedo a hablar, realmente casi un miedo existencial, tanto entre quienes eran sus críticos como entre sus colegas de negocios y sus amigos", afirmó Gibney antes de la proyección de "Musk". "Hablé con muchísima, muchísima, muchísima gente que, salvo algunas de las personas valientes que están aquí, se negaron a hablar". El director ejecutivo de Tesla y SpaceX ha desestimado la película, escribiendo este mes en su red social X que Gibney era parcial y que "obviamente iba a hacer el reportaje difamatorio más terrible y convincente sobre mí que se le pudiera ocurrir". SU VÍNCULO CON TRUMP Acompañado por la periodista Zoë Schiffer y Ashley St. Clair, antigua pareja de Musk y madre de uno de sus muchos hijos, Gibney explicó que comenzó a trabajar en el proyecto en 2023 y que, en un principio, había planeado una película menos ambiciosa. "Teníamos la intención de hacer una película más corta antes de que Elon Musk se viera envuelto en la carrera de Donald Trump y la presidencia de Estados Unidos", explicó Gibney, añadiendo que lo primero que hizo fue ponerse en contacto con Musk, quien se negó a ser entrevistado. Gibney, cuyos temas anteriores han incluido el colapso de la empresa energética Enron y la Cienciología, afirmó que el ascenso de Musk era "la historia del estafador", cuyo imperio se construyó sobre la capacidad de vender visiones exageradas y promesas sensacionalistas. Sin presentar necesariamente ninguna revelación impactante, la película vincula la adquisición de Twitter por parte de Musk, su campaña de recorte de gastos del Gobierno y su dependencia de los contratos federales con la creación de un poder y una riqueza sin precedentes en manos de un solo hombre. El documental utiliza una versión de Musk generada por IA que pronuncia frases que él mismo ha dicho a lo largo de los años. Cuando se le preguntó si esperaba enfrentamientos legales, Gibney respondió: "Consultamos a nuestros abogados y nos dieron luz verde para seguir adelante".

item.title: ULTIM'ORA MEDIO ORIENTE: Israele chiuderà consolato GB a Gerusalemme Est dopo sanzioni insediamenti
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 17.40 - Israele ha annunciato la chiusura del consolato britannico a Gerusalemme Est in risposta ai piani di Regno Unito, Francia e Canada di bloccare le importazioni provenienti dagli insediamenti israeliani in Cisgiordania. Inoltre, il Regno Unito non parteciperà più alla missione di coordinamento per Gaza guidata dagli Usa e ad alcuni funzionari britannici e altri cittadini del Regno Unito sarà vietato l’ingresso in Israele, ha affermato il ministro degli Esteri israeliano Gideon Saar. 12.40 - Il Qatar sta collaborando con alcuni partner della regione e di tutto il mondo, compresa la Cina, affinché riprendano i colloqui tra Stati Uniti e Iran. Lo ha detto un portavoce del ministero degli Esteri qatariota. Il primo ministro e ministro degli Esteri del Qatar, lo sceicco Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, si trova attualmente a Pechino alla guida di una delegazione. 12.00 - La Gran Bretagna annuncerà oggi un divieto commerciale sulle merci prodotte negli insediamenti israeliani in Cisgiordania. Lo ha comunicato un alto funzionario governativo, presentando la misura come un ulteriore passo a sostegno della soluzione a due Stati. È probabile che gli Stati Uniti si opporrano all'iniziativa e da Israele sono già arrivate reazioni di forte sdegno. Il ministro delle Finanze Bezalel Smotrich ha chiesto l'espulsione dell'ambasciatore britannico. Il ministro degli Esteri britannico Ed Miliband, a sei settimane dall'inizio del suo mandato, aveva già anticipato la settimana scorsa l'intenzione di ridefinire la politica nei confronti di Israele, e nel corso della giornata annuncerà le restrizioni commerciali. L'impatto sui circa 6 miliardi di sterline (8,12 miliardi di dollari) di scambi commerciali bilaterali annui sarà probabilmente minimo, anche perché non è ancora chiaro come la Gran Bretagna intenda distinguere le merci provenienti dagli insediamenti in Cisgiordania dai prodotti fabbricati in Israele.

item.title: Trump ha detto a Putin che vuole rapida fine guerra Ucraina, ripristino rapporti Usa-Russia -Cremlino
item.description: Il presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump ha detto al presidente russo Vladimir Putin, durante una telefonata, di volere una rapida fine della guerra in Ucraina, che consentirebbe il pieno ripristino dei rapporti tra Stati Uniti e Russia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump ha detto al presidente russo Vladimir Putin, durante una telefonata, di volere una rapida fine della guerra in Ucraina, che consentirebbe il pieno ripristino dei rapporti tra Stati Uniti e Russia. Lo riferisce il Cremlino. Yuri Ushakov, consigliere del Cremlino, ha riferito alla stampa che i due leader hanno discusso dell’esito della visita effettuata nel fine settimana dai negoziatori di pace Usa a Mosca e a Kiev che, secondo quanto ha affermato, entrambi i leader hanno valutato "con un segno più". Ha aggiunto che Putin ha illustrato a Trump ciò che, a suo avviso, gli Stati Uniti potrebbero fare per contribuire a porre fine al conflitto. Putin ha inoltre fornito a Trump la sua valutazione della situazione sul campo di battaglia e ha chiarito che la Russia non nutre intenzioni ostili nei confronti dell’Europa, ha detto Ushakov. "Donald Trump ha chiaramente sottolineato l'opportunità di porre fine al conflitto il prima possibile, il che aprirebbe immediatamente prospettive – notevoli e di vasta portata – per il pieno ripristino delle relazioni tra gli Stati Uniti e la Russia", ha affermato Ushakov. "A suo avviso, questo avrebbe un impatto in particolare sui legami commerciali ed economici, promettendo enormi benefici per entrambi i Paesi. Donald Trump desidera vedere una svolta durante la sua presidenza. Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin si è detto favorevole a questo approccio", ha aggiunto. Ushakov, secondo cui Putin e Trump si sono trovati d’accordo anche sulla necessità di proseguire gli scambi di prigionieri, ha detto di non poter rendere noti ulteriori dettagli su quanto discusso, ma ha definito la conversazione costruttiva e ha detto che i due leader hanno concordato di rimanere in contatto e parlare nuovamente al telefono qualora se ne presentasse la necessità.

item.title: Mps, procura chiede condanna 3 anni Tononi e Viola per contabilizzazione Npl
item.description: La procura di Milano ha chiesto oggi la condanna a tre anni di reclusione per l'ex presidente di Mps Massimo Tononi e per l'ex AD Fabrizio Viola nell'ambito del processo sulle presunte irregolarità nella contabilizzazione dei crediti deteriorati 2015 e nella prima semestrale del 2016.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La procura di Milano ha chiesto oggi la condanna a tre anni di reclusione per l'ex presidente di Mps (BMPS.MI) Massimo Tononi e per l'ex AD Fabrizio Viola nell'ambito del processo sulle presunte irregolarità nella contabilizzazione dei crediti deteriorati 2015 e nella prima semestrale del 2016. Al termine della requisitoria i pm milanesi hanno chiesto la condanna dei due ex dirigenti solo per un capo di imputazione di falso in bilancio per la semestrale 2016, considerando prescritte le imputazioni per il 2015. Gli imputati hanno sempre respinto le accuse. La procura ha inoltre chiesto l'assoluzione dell'ex dirigente preposto alle scritture contabili Arturo Betunio e dell'ex presidente Alessandro Profumo. Richieste di assoluzione anche per Tononi e Viola per tutti gli altri capi di imputazione. Dopo la procura, nelle prossime udienze toccherà agli avvocati delle migliaia di parti civili e infine alle arringhe delle difese, prima che i giudici si ritirino in camera di consiglio per la sentenza. Nella relazione semestrale, Banca Mps ha aggiornato al rialzo a 487 milioni di euro il valore complessivo delle richieste di risarcimento avanzate dalle 4.966 parti civili ammesse nel dibattimento. Il processo era iniziato nell'ottobre 2025 con le imputazioni, a vario titolo, di falso in bilancio, falso in prospetto e manipolazione del mercato. Nel giugno 2025 era infine stato disposto il non luogo a procedere per gli altri ex presidenti Alessandro Falciai e Stefania Bariatti, per l'ex AD Marco Morelli e per l'ex Cfo Nicola Clarelli, in relazione agli esercizi 2016 e 2017. (Emilio Parodi, editing Claudia Cristoferi, emilio.parodi@thomsonreuters.com ; +39 06 8030 7744)

item.title: Brennan takes fourth win in stage 16 of Vuelta after sprint finale
item.description: Briton Matthew Brennan (Team Visma-Lease a Bike) outsprinted the pack in the final straight to take victory in stage 16 of the Vuelta a Espana by a bike length on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Briton Matthew Brennan (Team Visma-Lease a Bike) outsprinted the pack in the final straight to take victory in stage 16 of the Vuelta a Espana by a bike length on Tuesday. After riding 181.1km from Cortegana to Palos de la Frontera on the south coast of Spain, Brennan became the first rider to win four stages of a grand tour in his maiden appearance since Colombian Fernando Gaviria in 2017. The day began with an early breakaway group of five riders separating from the peloton after 14km, stretching a lead out to two minutes 45 seconds. Over the course of the afternoon, the peloton ate away at that gap, led primarily by Visma-Lease a Bike's Steven Kruijswijk. Out of the hills and into temperatures rising to 37 degrees Celsius (98.6 degrees Fahrenheit), the gap continued to close until the breakaway was caught with 23km remaining. In the final 10km, a second trailing group met with the peloton, which was tightly bunched until the final kilometre, with Brennan's teammate Wout van Aert pushing out in front with the finish line in sight. The best efforts of runner-up Bryan Coquard (Cofidis) and Vito Braet (Lotto Intermarche) in third came too late, as Brennan launched comfortably off van Aert's wheel for the victory. Belgian van Aert finished sixth in the stage and remains the points leader, ahead of Brennan. "It's unbelievable. Four victories, and the plan was for one," said Brennan. "For the team, it's six, I've lost count, we've won so many." The Briton praised Van Aert for his role in leading him out, saying: "I really trusted Wout and followed his wheel all the way. It's incredible that he can put you in such a perfect position in such a chaotic race." Enric Mas kept a 2:06 lead in the general classification, as he seeks his first Vuelta triumph, ahead of Austrian Felix Gall and Slovenia's Primoz Roglic, who trails by 2:10. The Mallorcan came second in 2018, 2021 and 2022, while Mas' team Movistar are also seeking their first victory since 2016. Stage 17 begins on Wednesday on a flat 185km route from Dos Hermanas to Seville.

Which brings us to today’s Auto File… VW’s [USN:FWN44W0DY TEXT:"surprise win"] Dacia moves [USN:L8N44U20R TEXT:"Spring"] from China Automakers to Congress: [USN:L1N44V0NK TEXT:"keep China out"] VW gets nod for cuts Few expected Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume to succeed in getting his proposed massive job cuts approved by the automaker’s supervisory board, having [USN:L8N43B21S TEXT:"failed"] to do so just two months ago. But in a late-night surprise move, the board unanimously approved a turnaround package. You can read all about it [USN:FWN44W0DY TEXT:"here"]. The push to get approval included threatening a ‘nuclear option’ of calling an emergency general meeting to get shareholders to vote on cuts – a move that would likely have resulted in years of legal fights. According to great reporting from Reuters colleagues Christina Amann and Christoph Steitz, VW management’s willingness to use that nuclear option helped broker a deal with labor representatives and the German state of Lower Saxony, a key shareholder. Check it out [USN:L1N44W0B7 TEXT:"here"]. VW must still battle unions over its plan, but it has overcome its first major hurdle to change. item.title: AI construction crunch widens credit fault lines
item.description: About $500 bln of data-center debt has been issued this year already, but lender pricing and protections tell another part of the demand tale. Risk is recalibrating fastest for borrowers awaiting permits and power. The safety-to-speculation spread will only keep growing.
item.dc:creator: Sebastian Pellejero
item.content:encoded: Doubts about artificial intelligence are seeping into the system. Inside funding packages for sprawling data centers is evidence that investors have moved past the honeymoon phase. The sums are staggering. AI-related debt sold this year has reached nearly $500 billion through early August, Goldman Sachs analysts say. It accounts for about a fifth of all higher-rated U.S. issuance so far in 2026, up from 1% in 2024. Lenders are also charging more and demanding tougher terms to protect themselves against supply-chain bottlenecks and lengthening queues for electricity. Delivery represents a bigger concern than demand. Delays in obtaining microchips and local permits are pushing projected data center revenue further out. Public opposition and political wrangling make waits longer, too. A pause on new grid connections in Texas alone puts nearly 50 gigawatts of proposed projects, about a fifth of the U.S. pipeline, at risk of delay, according to BloombergNEF. Even safer borrowers encounter signs of resistance. Bonds issued by Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , Meta (META.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Oracle (ORCL.N) now trade at premiums to similarly rated non-AI credit. Orders for their debt dropped from nearly five times the amount on offer in February to less than two times in July, according to Torsten Slok, chief economist for lender and buyout shop Apollo Global Management. Higher yields are only part of the new safeguards. CyrusOne, a data-center developer owned by private equity firm KKR (KKR.N) and BlackRock’s (BLK.N) Global Infrastructure Partners, [USN:L4N4341D3 TEXT:"secured"] some $10 billion of financing in August, but cannot tap the portion intended for new construction until permits have been secured and leases signed. A Louisiana project backed by Meta earned an A+ credit rating, partly because Mark Zuckerberg's social-media giant promised to cover shortfalls in the site's value for 16 years if it walks away. Chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA.O) recently provided a similar backstop for OpenAI's campus in Ohio. Collateral is sometimes not enough to allay concerns either. To expand its Helios campus for AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , Galaxy Digital sold $3.5 billion of riskier BB-minus bonds in July at a roughly 10% yield, about three percentage points higher than the U.S. high-yield index, despite pledging the project’s assets as security. Longer-dated debt also faces concentration risks. Insurers, big buyers of such bonds, have already swallowed significant amounts. With data-center spending expected to approach $3 trillion through 2028, according to Morgan Stanley analysts, financing that follows the tempo of construction makes more sense. Private equity and infrastructure funds are helping, but the initial AI infatuation is officially over. Follow Sebastian Pellejero on LinkedIn . Blue Owl Capital said on August 28 that it led a $2.4 billion financing package for an IREN artificial intelligence data center campus in Canada, in one of the latest debt issues that have been flooding the market. The $1.2 billion senior secured term loan and $1.2 billion of senior secured notes will fund purchases of Nvidia compute equipment. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Consumidores están más preocupados por finanzas personales y empleo: reporte de Fed Nueva York
item.description: Las perspectivas de los consumidores estadounidenses respecto a la inflación apenas variaron en agosto, mientras aumentaban las preocupaciones de los hogares sobre el mercado laboral y la situación de sus finanzas personales, dijo el martes la Reserva Federal de Nueva York en un reporte.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Las perspectivas de los consumidores estadounidenses respecto a la inflación apenas variaron en agosto, mientras aumentaban las preocupaciones de los hogares sobre el mercado laboral y la situación de sus finanzas personales, dijo el martes la Reserva Federal de Nueva York en un reporte. La última "Encuesta sobre las expectativas de los consumidores" del banco regional de la Fed reveló que, en agosto, los encuestados se mantuvieron estables en sus previsiones de una inflación del 3,6% dentro de un año y del 3% dentro de cinco años, mientras que revisaron a la baja la inflación prevista para dentro de tres años, del 3,3% de julio al 3,2%. Según el reporte, los encuestados en agosto preveían un aumento de los precios de la gasolina dentro de un año. Aunque las previsiones de inflación de los hogares apenas variaron, sus perspectivas sobre la contratación y las finanzas personales se volvieron más inciertas. Las expectativas de los encuestados sobre cuál sería la tasa de desempleo dentro de un año aumentaron en agosto hasta alcanzar su nivel más alto desde abril de 2020, cuando la economía se veía devastada por la pandemia de COVID-19. El reporte señalaba que esta expectativa era generalizada en todos los grupos de edad, niveles de ingresos y niveles de estudios. Sin embargo, las expectativas de perder el empleo disminuyeron en agosto con respecto a julio. El reporte señala que la probabilidad de encontrar un nuevo trabajo en caso de pérdida involuntaria del empleo también se redujo en comparación con la encuesta de julio. Los consultados en la encuesta de agosto rebajaron sus valoraciones sobre su situación financiera actual y futura, así como sus opiniones sobre el acceso al crédito en la actualidad y dentro de un año. DATOS CLAVE SOBRE INFLACIÓN PREVISTOS PARA ESTA SEMANA El reporte se publicó una semana antes de que el banco central de Estados Unidos inicie una reunión de política monetaria de dos días. Existe una considerable incertidumbre sobre qué hará la Fed con su tasa de interés de referencia a un día, que actualmente se sitúa en el rango del 3,50%-3,75%, ya que los responsables de la política monetaria siguen enfrentándose a una inflación que se mantiene muy por encima del objetivo del 2% del banco central. La publicación el viernes del Índice de Precios al Consumo de agosto será fundamental para el resultado de la reunión de política monetaria del 15 y 16 de septiembre. Varios responsables de la Fed han sugerido que esos datos podrían resultar decisivos en su decisión de política monetaria. En su intervención el pasado jueves en un evento de Reuters NEXT Newsmaker, el gobernador de la Fed Christopher Waller afirmó que, en lo que respecta al próximo reporte sobre la inflación, "si se sigue avanzando hacia nuestro objetivo del 2%, entonces estoy dispuesto a apoyar el mantenimiento de la tasa de interés de referencia en su nivel actual". Otros responsables de la Fed, sin embargo, siguen dispuestos a subir las tasas. En una publicación en LinkedIn el viernes, la presidenta de la Fed de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, que votó a favor de una subida en la reunión de finales de julio, dijo que, dada la situación de la inflación a la que se enfrentan los habitantes de su distrito, "es hora de actuar" para reducir las presiones sobre los precios, lo que indica que sigue estando a favor de una subida de tasas en la reunión de la próxima semana.

item.title: 76ers, Flyers unveil new renderings of arena on former Spectrum site
item.description: The 76ers and Flyers on Tuesday unveiled exterior renderings of their new arena on the former Spectrum site in South Philadelphia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The 76ers and Flyers on Tuesday unveiled exterior renderings of their new arena on the former Spectrum site in South Philadelphia. The arena -- located next to where Xfinity Mobile Arena currently sits -- is scheduled to open in 2030, when Philadelphia's expansion WNBA team will begin play. Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment, which owns the Sixers, and Comcast Spectacor jointly own the privately funded venue in a 50-50 partnership. Comcast will own the naming rights of the new arena, which will receive a formal name at a later date. "This is a new era for Philadelphia sports," Comcast chairman Brian Roberts said. "To build our future where Ed Snider and the Spectrum made history makes this project truly special. Working with (Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment), we are creating a world-class experience worthy of Philadelphia's incredible fans." The new arena will feature more than a half-acre of outdoor space with fan plazas and food and beverage options. It also will have a staircase inspired by the steps at the Philadelphia Museum of Art, popularized by the film "Rocky." "Philly fans deserve the best arena in the world, and we are excited to partner with Comcast to deliver just that," Sixers managing partner Josh Harris said. "This privately funded arena will be the home to moments and memories that define this city for generations." The Spectrum opened in September 1967 as the first home for the new Flyers, along with hosting the existing 76ers. Both teams played there until 1996. "The first-look renderings reflect fan feedback and stakeholder input on the arena experience, public spaces and amenities," the teams said in a statement, per the Philadelphia Inquirer. "Fan surveys, focus groups, community engagement, and public review will continue throughout the design and approval process." NHL commissioner Gary Bettman called it a "state-of-the-art home worthy of the Flyers, their fans, and the entire city." NBA commissioner Adam Silver said it "promises to be an extraordinary home for NBA and WNBA basketball as well as many other world-class events." --Field Level Media

item.title: Football-L'ONG FairSquare saisit la Fifa pour dénoncer les liens d'Infantino avec Trump
item.description: Plus de 100.000 personnes ont signé une pétition exigeant l'ouverture d'une enquête par la Fifa sur son président Gianni Infantino pour des violations présumées du code d'éthique de l'instance en raison de ses liens avec le président américain Donald Trump, a déclaré mardi l'organisation non gouvernementale britannique FairSquare.
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair
item.content:encoded: Plus de 100.000 personnes ont signé une pétition exigeant l'ouverture d'une enquête par la Fifa sur son président Gianni Infantino pour des violations présumées du code d'éthique de l'instance en raison de ses liens avec le président américain Donald Trump, a déclaré mardi l'organisation non gouvernementale britannique FairSquare. La plainte a été déposée par FairSquare dans le cadre de sa campagne "Reboot Fifa", qui accuse Gianni Infantino de multiples infractions détaillées dans une lettre adressée à la commission d’éthique de la Fifa et consultée par Reuters. Les allégations portent notamment sur un abus de pouvoir, le non-respect des obligations de neutralité politique et la violation des obligations de loyauté dans le but de "s'attirer les faveurs du président américain". Nicholas McGeehan, directeur de FairSquare, a déclaré que cette plainte, qui fait suite à une première datant de décembre 2025, avait été déposée à la suite des événements survenus pendant et après la Coupe du monde qui s’est achevée en juillet. Parmi les reproches figurent notamment l'intervention de Donald Trump pendant le Mondial pour demander de réexaminer le carton rouge de l'attaquant américain Folarin Balogun, dont la suspension automatique avait été levée, ainsi que la proposition avortée de Gianni Infantino de céder une partie des droits commerciaux de la Coupe du monde à des investisseurs privés. "Les accusations sont beaucoup plus graves. Nous sommes désormais confrontés à une inquiétude publique et politique et nous avons estimé qu'il était temps de mettre à nouveau la pression sur la commission d'éthique de la Fifa", a déclaré Nicholas McGeehan à Reuters. La plainte énumère huit incidents, notamment des allégations selon lesquelles Gianni Infantino aurait enfreint la neutralité politique de l'instance en soutenant publiquement Donald Trump et abusé de son autorité en créant puis en décernant unilatéralement le Prix de la paix de la Fifa au président américain sans l’approbation ni l’implication de son conseil. Le président de l'instance est également accusé d’avoir abusé de son autorité en développant secrètement le projet "Fifa Forward Enterprise" avec des investisseurs ayant des liens politiques, tout en contournant les procédures de gouvernance de la Fifa. Une proposition qui a finalement été abandonnée à la suite d'un tollé mondial. Nicholas McGeehan a expliqué que FairSquare souhaitait que Gianni Infantino soit suspendu de toute activité liée au football pendant deux ans. "Cette plainte va bien au-delà de la seule personne d’Infantino", a-t-il ajouté. "Il s’agit de démontrer aux responsables politiques qui devraient examiner de près la conduite de la Fifa et sa gouvernance que l'organisation est incapable de se réguler elle‑même." Reuters a contacté la Fifa pour obtenir un commentaire. En juillet, le Comité international olympique (CIO) a rejeté une plainte déposée par FairSquare à l'encontre de Gianni Infantino, au sujet de son soutien affiché à Donald Trump, estimant que cette affaire ne relevait pas de la compétence de sa commission d’éthique. Le dirigeant briguera en mars un quatrième mandat à la présidence de la Fifa, aucun adversaire crédible ne s’étant pour l’instant manifesté.

item.title: Kane, Haaland, Messi on Ballon d'Or shortlist, Vozinha gets Yashin nomination
item.description: Harry Kane, Erling Haaland and Lionel Messi have all made the 30-man shortlist for the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or, while Cape Verde's World Cup hero Vozinha has been nominated for the Yashin award, organisers France Football announced on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Harry Kane, Erling Haaland and Lionel Messi have all made the 30-man shortlist for the 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or, while Cape Verde's World Cup hero Vozinha has been nominated for the Yashin award, organisers France Football announced on Tuesday. Kane had a stunning season with Bayern Munich and England, scoring 73 goals for club and country in 65 matches and helped secure a treble of Bundesliga, German Cup, and German Super Cup as well as leading his nation to the World Cup semi-finals. Haaland netted 58 goals in 64 games for Manchester City and Norway, while eight-times Ballon d'Or winner Messi had 75 goal contributions in 49 matches for Inter Miami and Argentina, who he helped to reached the World Cup final. Also among those on the shortlist are Jude Bellingham, Kylian Mbappe, Ousmane Dembele and Lamine Yamal but not five-times winner Cristiano Ronaldo despite the Portugal forward lifting the Saudi Pro League title with Al-Nassr. The women's shortlist includes Poland's Barcelona quadruple-winner Ewa Pajor, Alexia Putellas, who featured for Barca and Spain but has now joined London City Lionesses, and Manchester City's prolific Jamaica striker Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw. Cape Verde's Vozinha was nominated for the Yashin Trophy awarded to the best goalkeeper, with his standout World Cup performances putting him on the 10-man shortlist after he helped his country advance from the tournament's group stage. He will compete against Spain's World Cup-winner Unai Simon and Argentina's Emi Martinez plus fellow African nominees Yassine Bounou and Edouard Mendy. The 70th edition of the Ballon d'Or will be staged in London for the first time at a ceremony on October 26 as a tribute to Stanley Matthews, who won the first Ballon d'Or.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow voter verification database blocked by judge
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration asked the U.S. Supreme Court on Tuesday to allow it to use a revamped immigration database for checking the accuracy of state voter rolls, one of a series of actions that boosts federal involvement in voting ahead of November's midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: John Kruzel
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump 's administration asked the U.S. Supreme Court on Tuesday to allow it to use a revamped immigration database for checking the accuracy of state voter rolls, one of a series of actions that boosts federal involvement in voting ahead of November's midterm elections. Justice Department lawyers asked the court to halt a Washington, D.C.-based federal judge's June ruling that blocked the mass voter verification system, which the judge said was haphazardly assembled and contained unreliable citizenship data. "The district court has issued an indefensible order that threatens the integrity of upcoming elections by vacating the federal government's authority to internally use Social Security data when fulfilling its duty to respond to requests by states to verify the citizenship of individuals for voting and other purposes," Justice Department lawyers wrote in a filing.

item.title: GB-Un problème technique perturbe les vols au départ des principaux aéroports
item.description: L'organisme britannique chargé du contrôle aérien NATS faisait face mardi à un problème technique qui provoque des perturbations dans les principaux aéroports du Royaume-Uni.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'organisme britannique chargé du contrôle aérien NATS faisait face mardi à un problème technique qui provoque des perturbations dans les principaux aéroports du Royaume-Uni. "Nous avons identifié un problème avec notre système de procédure de vol. Nos ingénieurs sont sur site et travaillent urgemment pour rétablir dès que possible un fonctionnement normal", déclare-t-il dans un communiqué. "Les avions continuent de décoller et l'espace aérien reste ouvert mais le retour à la normale prendra un certain temps." L'aéroport d'Heathrow à Londres, le plus grand de Grande-Bretagne, a déclaré travailler en lien avec l'organisme pour un retour à la normale le plus rapidement possible. Les aéroports d'Edimbourg en Ecosse et de Dublin en Irlande ont également fait état de perturbations. Les arrivées et départs dans les aéroports de la région de Londres faisaient l'objet d'une réglementation stricte, a rapporté sur X le site de suivi des vols Flightradar24.

item.title: China's Xi tells UK's Burnham they have more common interests than differences
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping struck a positive tone in a phone call with Britain's new Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday, saying that Beijing and London share greater common interests than differences.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese President Xi Jinping struck a positive tone in a phone call with Britain's new Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday, saying that Beijing and London share greater common interests than differences. Xi said there was a need to "overcome differences, seek common ground, and expand mutually beneficial cooperation", while adding that the two countries could work together on technology, education, healthcare and the financial sector. Tuesday's call — the first publicly known conversation between the two leaders since Burnham became Britain's prime minister — was held at the latter's invitation, according to the official Chinese summary released by its foreign ministry. A readout from Burnham's office said the leaders discussed the "importance of pragmatic cooperation", including on economic growth and raising living standards for people in both their countries. “The Prime Minister said that he would engage frankly and constructively on issues that matter for both countries, and raised domestic security, Russia's war in Ukraine, Hong Kong, human rights and consular cases of particular importance," a Downing Street spokesperson said. Relations between China and Britain have warmed in recent months, in part due to former British leader Keir Starmer's trip to Beijing in January, when China agreed to extend a visa-free scheme to Britons and halve tariffs on whisky. The rapprochement also reflected a shared interest in diversifying trade relationships amid growing friction with Washington. As major global economies, "China and Britain both support multilateralism and open trade" and should step up coordination through multilateral frameworks, Xi said during Tuesday's call. "Both China and Britain are major technology powers ... and should maintain an open and forward-looking outlook and strengthen exchanges and cooperation across a range of fields," he added. Likely in reference to Britain's nationalisation of Chinese steelmaker-owned British Steel, Xi told Burnham he hopes Britain can "fully protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese investors."

item.title: Produção de veículos no Brasil cresce em agosto, diz Anfavea
item.description: O Brasil produziu 271,2 mil veículos em agosto, alta de 6,8% em relação a julho e crescimento de 9,4% ante o mesmo período do ano passado, de acordo com dados divulgados nesta terça-feira pela Associação Nacional dos Fabricantes de Veículos Automotores (Anfavea).
item.dc:creator: Michael Susin
item.content:encoded: O Brasil produziu 271,2 mil veículos em agosto, alta de 6,8% em relação a julho e crescimento de 9,4% ante o mesmo período do ano passado, de acordo com dados divulgados nesta terça-feira pela Associação Nacional dos Fabricantes de Veículos Automotores (Anfavea). No acumulado do ano, a produção somou quase 1,9 milhão de veículos, expansão de 8,5% ante os mesmos oito meses de 2025. De acordo com o presidente da entidade, Igor Calvet, o setor teve o melhor agosto desde 2013 e ainda deve se beneficiar de um mercado aquecido até o final do ano em meio à forte concorrência devido ao crescimento expressivo dos veículos importados. As vendas de veículos em agosto recuaram 1,6% na base mensal, mas saltaram 22,1% ano a ano, para 275,1 mil unidades. No acumulado de 2026, os emplacamentos somaram 1,975 milhão de unidades, alta de 18,4%. Em apresentação dos resultados para a imprensa, Calvet destacou que o próximo ano deve ser marcado por uma reorganização do setor, com um possível impacto na produção local de veículos como consequência do estabelecimento de imposto de importação para os kits de veículos completamente desmontados, conhecidos como CKD, e a diminuição dos estoques. "Nossas empresas associadas têm demonstrado confiança anunciando investimentos de longo prazo. A gente acredita em um potencial muito estrutural do mercado brasileiro. É um crescimento que está longe de chegar no potencial pelo tamanho do mercado", disse. O setor terminou agosto com estoque de 506 mil veículos ante 525 mil em julho, suficiente para 50 dias de vendas. Do total em estoque, 324 mil são modelos importados, segundo a Anfavea. As exportações de agosto, porém, caíram 31,7% ante agosto de 2025, acumulando no ano queda de 22,9%, para 294,1 mil veículos, segundo os dados da Anfavea. A entidade citou queda de 36,6% no ano nos embarques para a Argentina, principal mercado do setor no Brasil.

item.title: Cobre se apresta a probar la barrera de los 15.000 dólares esta misma semana: analistas
item.description: Los precios del cobre podrían superar los 15.000 dólares por primera vez ya esta misma semana, dijeron analistas el martes, mientras los inversores se preparan para una nueva ronda de datos económicos de Estados Unidos y el presidente Donald Trump mantiene al mercado en vilo con respecto a los aranceles.
item.dc:creator: Tom Daly
item.content:encoded: Los precios del cobre podrían superar los 15.000 dólares por primera vez ya esta misma semana, dijeron analistas el martes, mientras los inversores se preparan para una nueva ronda de datos económicos de Estados Unidos y el presidente Donald Trump mantiene al mercado en vilo con respecto a los aranceles. El cobre de referencia en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME) alcanzó un máximo histórico de 14.779 dólares por tonelada, subiendo por cuarta sesión consecutiva sin que el repunte dé señales de ralentizarse. "¿Llegará a los 15.000 dólares esta semana debido a la confusión arancelaria de Trump? Claro, es posible", dijo Tom Price, analista de Panmure Liberum. "Puedes elegir cualquier cifra elevada cuando hay tanto capital especulativo detrás de una idea de inversión". Estados Unidos ha propuesto un arancel del 15% sobre las importaciones de cobre refinado a partir de principios de 2027, que se elevaría al 30% en 2028, pero no ha confirmado ni descartado dicho arancel. La perspectiva de los aranceles ha provocado que grandes volúmenes de cobre fluyan hacia los almacenes homologados por la Comex estadounidense, lo que ha mermado las existencias en la LME y en China, el principal consumidor de metales. Con algo más de 300.000 toneladas en total, las existencias de cobre de la LME y de la Bolsa de Futuros de Shangái (ShFE) son menos de la mitad de Comex , en máximos históricos de 695.624 toneladas, con una ventana de arbitraje abierta que contribuye a impulsar las importaciones récord de Estados Unidos. Es probable que los eventos macroeconómicos de esta semana determinen si el alza del precio del cobre se mantiene, según Alastair Munro, de Marex, quien señaló los detalles sobre la recompra de bonos del Tesoro prevista para el miércoles y los datos del Índice de Precios al Consumo (IPC) de Estados Unidos correspondientes a agosto, que se publicarán el viernes. El cobre podría ser vulnerable a la toma de ganancias si el dólar (.DXY) se recupera tras la publicación del IPC, señaló la correduría Sucden Financial en una nota. Una moneda estadounidense más fuerte encarece los metales cotizados en el billete verde para los inversores que utilizan otras divisas. No obstante, aún hay margen para nuevas subidas si el cobre se mantiene por encima de los 14.400 dólares, señaló Sucden. La previsión de Morgan Stanley para el cuarto trimestre, de 14.250 dólares, podría superarse en función de cómo y cuándo se tome cualquier decisión sobre aranceles, afirmó Amy Gower, directora de estrategia de metales y materias primas mineras del banco, que mantiene una visión positiva sobre el cobre para el resto de 2026. "No obstante, nos mostramos más cautos de cara a 2027, año en el que es probable que la demanda de importaciones de Estados Unidos se debilite, tanto si se aplican aranceles como si se descartan", indicó. Mientras no haya claridad sobre los aranceles, el cobre debería seguir subiendo, señaló John Meyer, analista de SP Angel. "Hay mucho cobre físico en el mundo, pero todo está en Estados Unidos", señaló.

item.title: Refugios de la frontera mexicana se vacían, medidas de Trump disuaden migración al norte
item.description: Los centros de acogida para migrantes situados a lo largo de la frontera norte de México se están quedando vacíos, ya que cada vez son menos los migrantes que se dirigen a Estados Unidos tras las medidas de represión migratoria y la campaña de deportaciones masivas del presidente Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Jose Luis Gonzalez
item.content:encoded: Los centros de acogida para migrantes situados a lo largo de la frontera norte de México se están quedando vacíos, ya que cada vez son menos los migrantes que se dirigen a Estados Unidos tras las medidas de represión migratoria y [USN:L1N3R103D TEXT:"la campaña de deportaciones masivas"] del presidente Donald Trump. Para Salomé Villena, una migrante ecuatoriana que en su día planeaba cruzar a Estados Unidos con su marido y sus dos hijos, de 4 y 6 años, los cambios en la política de inmigración estadounidense la obligaron a modificar esos planes. En su lugar, la familia ha decidido quedarse en Ciudad Juárez, donde se encuentran entre las pocas personas que aún permanecen en un centro de acogida local. "Nuestra intención era cruzar a Estados Unidos, pero con lo que hizo Trump, pues no pudimos", explicó Villena, refiriéndose a las políticas que han dificultado el acceso a las vías legales de migración. La familia también se planteó pagar a un traficante de personas para que los llevara al otro lado de la frontera, pero descartó la idea después de que, según cuentan, el hombre empezara a robarles el dinero. El regreso de Trump al poder [USN:S0N3NY010 TEXT:"cerró de forma abrupta"] una de las principales vías legales que los migrantes habían utilizado para entrar en Estados Unidos, poniendo [USN:S0N3NY010 TEXT:"fin a"] la aplicación CBP One, que permitía a los solicitantes de asilo concertar citas en los puertos de entrada. La medida dejó a miles de migrantes varados en localidades fronterizas como Ciudad Juárez y llevó a las autoridades mexicanas a prepararse para un aumento de los deportados mediante la apertura [USN:L3N3OI00G TEXT:"de refugios de emergencia"]. Sin embargo, muchas de esas instalaciones permanecieron prácticamente vacías, ya que las llegadas de migrantes disminuyeron y las deportaciones se llevaban a cabo a menudo por vía aérea hacia el sur de México u [USN:S0N42V04S TEXT:"otros países"]. La disminución de los flujos migratorios se ha dejado sentir en toda la red de refugios de Ciudad Juárez. Juan Fierro, que dirige el refugio "El Buen Samaritano" de esa población aledaña a la estadounidense El Paso, afirmó que las políticas de Trump habían reducido drásticamente el número de recién llegados. "Cada vez a las personas les ponen más complicado, más difícil, el que puedan venir a la frontera norte de México y poder cruzar a los Estados Unidos", señaló. Este cambio ha alterado la composición de la población migrante de la ciudad, señaló Dirvan García, del Consejo Estatal de Población (Coespo). "Estamos viviendo un momento completamente distinto", afirmó García. "Hay una cantidad importante de personas que en un primer momento tenían la intención de cruce que en estos en estos momentos están generando arraigo en la ciudad". García dijo que los drásticos recortes presupuestarios y el descenso en la llegada de migrantes habían reducido el número de centros de acogida de la red del Coespo casi a la mitad, hasta 18. Sin embargo, la ocupación se mantiene en torno al 15%, y la mayoría de los residentes son ahora mexicanos desplazados por [USN:L6N44S19B TEXT:"la violencia"]. Los que no son mexicanos son principalmente migrantes procedentes de Venezuela, Colombia y Centroamérica, añadió.

item.title: Qualcomm e Amazon fecham acordo de US$4 bi para chips personalizados
item.description: A Qualcomm anunciou nesta terça-feira que emitiu um warrant à Amazon , concedendo-lhe o direito de adquirir uma participação de cerca de US$4 bilhões, como parte de uma parceria para desenvolver chips personalizados para data centers de IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Qualcomm (QCOM.O) anunciou nesta terça-feira que emitiu um warrant à Amazon (AMZN.O) , concedendo-lhe o direito de adquirir uma participação de cerca de US$4 bilhões, como parte de uma parceria para desenvolver chips personalizados para data centers de IA. As ações da fabricante de chips sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, subiram mais de 7% no início do pregão. O valor das ações caiu cerca de 1% neste ano, já que uma recuperação em agosto compensou apenas parcialmente as perdas acentuadas provocadas pela menor demanda por smartphones. O warrant permite que a Amazon compre ações da Qualcomm a US$161,26 cada e está vinculado a negócios de até US$60 bilhões no âmbito do acordo, de acordo com um documento regulatório. As empresas trabalharão juntas no desenvolvimento de chips para inferência de IA, um mercado em rápido crescimento focado na execução de modelos de IA treinados, que se tornou um importante campo de batalha entre as empresas de chips. A Qualcomm e a Amazon também desenvolverão tecnologias de conectividade óptica de alta velocidade, incluindo soluções que chegam a 1,6 terabits por segundo, para atender às crescentes demandas de largura de banda em data centers de IA. Como parte da parceria, a Qualcomm planeja ampliar o uso dos serviços de inteligência artificial e da infraestrutura da AWS para cargas de trabalho de projeto de chips, com o objetivo de reduzir os ciclos de desenvolvimento. (Reportagem de Anhata Rooprai em Bengaluru)

item.title: Equatorial Guinea police pull guns on migrants deported by Trump, witnesses say
item.description: Police in Equatorial Guinea pulled firearms on migrants deported there from the United States, according to three witnesses and video footage shared with Reuters, intensifying concerns about the treatment and safety of people sent to the Central African nation under a U.S. deportation programme.
item.dc:creator: Robbie Corey-Boulet
item.content:encoded: Police in Equatorial Guinea pulled firearms on migrants deported there from the United States, according to three witnesses and video footage shared with Reuters, intensifying concerns about the treatment and safety of people sent to the Central African nation under a U.S. deportation programme. Deportees have [USN:L6N42D0I0 TEXT:"complained"] of inadequate medical care, denial of legal assistance and "severe psychological distress" while being held at a hotel in Equatorial Guinea's former capital, Malabo. The altercation on Saturday began as a dispute over access to mobile phones but quickly escalated, with men wearing shirts bearing the words "National Police" pointing what appeared to be semi-automatic assault rifles at deportees inside the entrance to the hotel. One migrant appeared to be kneeling on the ground while others screamed nearby. Reuters reviewed the footage but could not independently verify the events that preceded the confrontation. The Trump administration has since last year struck [USN:L6N44F16V TEXT:"multiple agreements"] with African governments to accept migrants who it cannot legally return to their home countries. Many of those deported under the so-called third-country arrangements had previously won protection from U.S. immigration judges, who found they could face torture or other abuses if repatriated. Washington has defended the third-country deals as lawful and said deportations are carried out in accordance with U.S. immigration law. Equatorial Guinea has not publicly detailed the terms under which it is housing the deportees. Rights groups and advocates have said the arrangements are opaque and that some deportees are ultimately returned to the countries they originally fled. Lawyers representing some of the deportees said the confrontation underscored concerns about their safety. "Once again, evidence demonstrates that deporting people to Equatorial Guinea is putting their lives in danger. I hope that someone will not be seriously injured or killed," said Meredyth Yoon, litigation director for Asian Americans Advancing Justice-Atlanta, a legal advocacy group. The Trump administration is "utilizing all lawful options" to carry out deportations, said a spokesperson for the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. "When an individual is no longer in ICE custody then ICE will no longer be responsible for them. This is common sense," the spokesperson said, referring to Immigration and Customs Enforcement. A State Department spokesperson said the U.S. government would "use all legal means to remove those with no right to remain in our country." The government of Equatorial Guinea did not respond to requests for comment. 'THEY COCKED THEIR GUNS... TELLING ME TO GET ON MY KNEES' There are currently 31 deportees being held at the hotel in Malabo, according to Yoon and two members of the group of deportees. Last month, [USN:L6N44I0UN TEXT:"five people"] whom the U.S. attempted to deport to Liberia resisted getting off the plane and were subsequently transported to Equatorial Guinea instead. One member of that group, a Cuban man, approached police officers at the hotel on Saturday morning to request the return of his confiscated mobile phone so that he could contact relatives and a lawyer, the two witnesses said. The officers ignored his request, and another deportee, an Egyptian man named Ahmed Soliman, began filming the exchange on his phone. Within 30 seconds, "I was rushed at by multiple officers, me and a few other people that were outside with us. That is when they started assaulting us, grabbing my neck, my shirt, trying to dig the phone out of my pocket," Soliman told Reuters. "They cocked their guns, took it off of safety, pointed their guns at me telling me to get on my knees, with my hands up... I had to remain in that position for 10-15 minutes while there was chaos going on in the hotel." The situation was defused when the hotel's director arrived and "calmed everyone down", allowing the deportees to return to their rooms, Soliman said. A total of 53 people were deported to Equatorial Guinea under the third-country deportation deal between November 2025 and July, according to Third Country Deportation Watch, a tracker managed by Refugees International and Human Rights First. They come from 11 African countries as well as Georgia, Jamaica, Brazil and Cuba, according to the tracker. Three deportees told Reuters they had been encouraged to return to their home countries despite fears of torture and other abuses, and said they had not been presented with alternative options. Reuters could not independently verify the claim.

item.title: Trump dijo a Putin que quiere que la guerra en Ucrania termine pronto y restablecer relaciones: Kremlin
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comunicó el martes al presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, en una conversación telefónica, que deseaba un rápido fin a la guerra en Ucrania, lo que permitiría restablecer plenamente las relaciones entre Washington y Moscú, según el Kremlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comunicó el martes al presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, en una conversación telefónica, que deseaba un rápido fin a la guerra en Ucrania, lo que permitiría restablecer plenamente las relaciones entre Washington y Moscú, según el Kremlin. El asesor del Kremlin, Yuri Ushakov, dijo a periodistas que ambos mandatarios analizaron los resultados de la visita realizada el fin de semana por los negociadores de paz estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner a Moscú y Kiev. Ambos líderes valoraron "de forma positiva" el viaje, según Ushakov, que agregó que Putin le comunicó a Trump lo que, en su opinión, Estados Unidos podría hacer para ayudar a poner fin al conflicto. Witkoff y Kushner —a instancias de Trump— están intentando dar un nuevo impulso a las negociaciones estancadas destinadas a encontrar una forma de poner fin a los combates y han planteado la posibilidad de que se reanuden las conversaciones a tres bandas entre Rusia, Ucrania y Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, Ushakov no hizo mención alguna al respecto el martes. El asesor agregó que Putin había transmitido a Trump su valoración de la situación en el campo de batalla y había dejado claro que Rusia no tenía planes hostiles hacia Europa. "Donald Trump hizo hincapié claramente en la conveniencia de poner fin al conflicto lo antes posible, lo que abriría de inmediato perspectivas —impresionantes y de gran alcance, por cierto— para el restablecimiento pleno de las relaciones entre Estados Unidos y Rusia", dijo Ushakov. "En su opinión, esto tendría un impacto especial en los vínculos comerciales y económicos, lo que prometería enormes beneficios para ambos países. Donald Trump está muy interesado en que se logre un avance decisivo durante su presidencia. Vladímir Vladímírovich Putin apoyó este enfoque". Ushakov —quien señaló que Putin y Trump también habían coincidido en la necesidad de continuar con los intercambios de prisioneros— dijo que no podía entrar en más detalles sobre lo que se había discutido, pero calificó la conversación de fructífera y señaló que ambos líderes habían acordado mantenerse en contacto y volver a hablar por teléfono si surge la necesidad.

item.title: Aneel propõe que distribuidoras de energia possam controlar 33 GW de geração distribuída
item.description: A Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) aprovou nesta terça-feira a consulta pública sobre uma proposta de mudanças técnicas que permitiriam às distribuidoras de energia controlarem até 33 gigawatts (GW) em recursos de geração distribuída de energia, como mini usinas solares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) aprovou nesta terça-feira a consulta pública sobre uma proposta de mudanças técnicas que permitiriam às distribuidoras de energia controlarem até 33 gigawatts (GW) em recursos de geração distribuída de energia, como mini usinas solares. O plano vem para tratar das consequências do crescimento da geração própria de energia no Brasil, principalmente solar, em telhados residenciais e fachadas. Esses sistemas distribuídos, que não são gerenciáveis pelo Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS), têm desafiado o equilíbrio entre carga e geração na rede nacional. O Brasil passou a conviver com riscos crescentes de apagões decorrentes do excesso de energia na rede, proveniente principalmente da geração distribuída solar, o que levou à adoção de [USN:L1N44L0LP TEXT:"medidas emergenciais"] e motivou Aneel e ONS a estudar formas de ampliar o monitoramento e o controle desses sistemas. A proposta da Aneel não abrangeria os microgeradores, como telhados solares em residências, e sim sistemas de porte maior conectados à rede de distribuição de energia. Empreendimentos como mini usinas solares e outros passariam a ser geridos pelas concessionárias, que poderiam ordenar cortes de geração, a exemplo do que o ONS faz com os grandes parques eólicos e solares. Os novos requisitos de procedimentos de rede alcançariam aproximadamente 70 mil instalações conectadas às distribuidoras de energia, somando mais de 33 GW de potência instalada. São 1,5 mil centrais "Tipo III", como pequenas centrais hidrelétricas (PCHs) e pequenas térmicas a biomassa, e cerca de 68 mil instalações de minigeração, com mais de 13 GW de potência. Em seu voto, a diretora relatora, Agnes da Costa, destacou que o modelo atual precisa ser revisto, uma vez que o setor elétrico deixou de operar apenas com fluxos unidirecionais de energia e passou a incorporar recursos capazes tanto de injetar quanto de absorver potência, como telhados solares, sistemas de armazenamento em baterias e veículos elétricos. Já o diretor-geral da Aneel, Sandoval Feitosa, ressaltou que a situação da geração distribuída de energia no Brasil precisa ser endereçada, já que tende a se agravar. "Não dá para um recurso tão relevante, tão importante, de geração de energia não ficar observável (pelo ONS) e literalmente descontrolável", disse Feitosa, durante reunião nesta terça-feira. A proposta da Aneel fica sob consulta pública por 60 dias, de 10 de setembro a 9 de novembro.

item.title: Lawyer asks Trump to pardon Lindsay Clancy after mistrial in Massachusetts murder case
item.description: The lawyer for Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose murder trial ended in a mistrial last week, asked President Donald Trump on Tuesday to pardon her, despite the fact that the case was prosecuted under state law.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: The lawyer for Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother whose murder trial [USN:L1N44V0ZD TEXT:"ended in a mistrial"] last week, asked President Donald Trump on Tuesday to pardon her, despite the fact that the case was prosecuted under state law. Trump said last week he had been following Clancy's trial. The 36-year-old mother was accused of killing her three children in their home in January 2023. “Mr. President, I would hope that you would consider this young lady, the type of person she is and what she’s been through, and consider a pardon,” attorney Kevin Reddington said at the end of an interview on ABC's "Good Morning America." A president's pardon power applies only to federal crimes, and Clancy was prosecuted under state law. Trump has nevertheless taken a broad view of his clemency powers and applied them in some cases tried in state courts. Asked about the Clancy pardon request, the White House referred to the president's previous comments on the case. “She did a horrible, horrible thing. Can't be worse,” Trump told reporters after a state judge declared a mistrial because jurors could not reach a unanimous verdict. “But you'll find out what the price to pay is. There'll be a price. It's going to be mental institution or jail or something.” At trial, Clancy's lawyers argued she was not guilty by reason of insanity, saying she was experiencing a psychotic episode caused by postpartum psychosis. Prosecutors argued the killings were premeditated. The state could now seek a retrial. Last December, Trump [USN:FWN3XH1H0 TEXT:"pardoned"] former Colorado county clerk Tina Peters, a Trump ally who had been convicted on state charges related to voting machine tampering. The pardon was largely viewed as symbolic because Peters was prosecuted under state law. But the move added political pressure on Colorado Governor Jared Polis, a Democrat, given questions about Peters' nine-year prison sentence. Polis granted Peters clemency in May, and she later appeared with Trump in the Oval Office.

item.title: OpenAI, New York Times case tees up key test of AI training under copyright law
item.description: OpenAI, Microsoft , the New York Times and a group of prominent authors have laid out sharply differing views on one of the highest-stakes questions in copyright law in their dispute over AI training.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: OpenAI, Microsoft (MSFT.O) , the New York Times (NYT.N) and a group of prominent authors have laid out sharply differing views on one of the highest-stakes questions in copyright law in their dispute over AI training. The tech companies and copyright owners both asked U.S. District Judge Sidney Stein in Manhattan on Friday for rulings in their favor on the companies' "fair use" defense, which is likely to determine which side wins the case. The Times' lawsuit, first [USN:L1N3DM0O2 TEXT:"filed in 2023"], accuses OpenAI and its largest financial backer Microsoft of using millions of newspaper articles without permission to train ChatGPT. A group of authors, including John Grisham, Jonathan Franzen and George R.R. Martin, [USN:L1N3AW1AA TEXT:"separately sued"] the companies the same year for using their books to train OpenAI's popular chatbot. Those cases and other related lawsuits were [USN:L6N3QH0VL TEXT:"consolidated in New York"] last year. Dozens of [USN:L6N3XM122 TEXT:"other complaints"] have also been brought by copyright owners against tech companies over what they call the theft of their material to train AI systems. The pending cases will likely turn on whether AI systems make fair use of copyrighted material by using it to create transformative new content. The first two judges to consider the issue issued [USN:L6N3XM122 TEXT:"diverging rulings"] last year. U.S. District Judge William Alsup in San Francisco [USN:L6N3S50SQ TEXT:"called Anthropic's use of books"] for AI training “quintessentially transformative." Judge Vince Chhabria, also in San Francisco, [USN:L6N3S10OC TEXT:"ruled for Meta"] in a similar case two days later and also called its use of copyrighted books transformative. Chhabria warned, however, that AI training would not be fair use “in many circumstances” and raised concerns that generative AI could “flood the market” with content that competes with human creators. The authors echoed Chhabria in their filing on Friday, arguing that AI is "diluting the market for books across the board," and that fair use "does not countenance such catastrophic threats to the incentive to create." In their brief, the news outlets said that ChatGPT diverts users from their websites and also displaces the market for their work. "Defendants’ competitive exploitation of Plaintiffs' expressive works cannot be excused" under court precedent, the outlets said. Citing Alsup, OpenAI told the Manhattan court that the use of copyrighted work for AI training is "among the most transformative many of us will see in our lifetimes" and said that its technology has not harmed writers. "The purpose of OpenAI’s pretraining process was to derive broad, unprotectable statistical patterns related to language that can be used to create new text, not reproduce protected expression," OpenAI said in a brief addressing the authors' case. Microsoft also told Stein on Friday that fears that LLMs would displace authors and journalists were unfounded. "Plaintiffs began this case speculating that LLMs would destroy their very livelihoods," Microsoft said in a brief addressing the authors' case. "Years of discovery later, the record is clear: Neither LLM training nor the use of LLMs in products substitutes for copyrighted books.” The case is In re OpenAI Inc Copyright Infringement Litigation, U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, No. 1:25-md-03143. For OpenAI: Andrew Gass of Latham & Watkins, Joseph Gratz of Morrison & Foerster, Robert Van Nest of Keker Van Nest & Peters For Microsoft: Annette Hurst of Orrick Herrington & Sutcliffe For the authors: Justin Nelson of Susman Godfrey For the news outlets: Ian Crosby and Davida Brook of Susman Godfrey

item.title: Argentino Mac Allister muestra tristeza por no haber recibido nueva oferta de contrato del Liverpool
item.description: El centrocampista del Liverpool Alexis Mac Allister expresó el martes su tristeza tras no recibir una nueva oferta de contrato y dijo que había barajado sus opciones de traspaso en declaraciones previas al partido de la Liga de Campeones del miércoles contra el Atlético de Madrid en Anfield.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El centrocampista del Liverpool Alexis Mac Allister expresó el martes su tristeza tras no recibir una nueva oferta de contrato y dijo que había barajado sus opciones de traspaso en declaraciones previas al partido de la Liga de Campeones del miércoles contra el Atlético de Madrid en Anfield. El internacional argentino de 27 años, al que le quedan dos años de contrato, dijo que el Liverpool le comunicó que no podía ofrecerle nuevas condiciones, a diferencia de lo ocurrido con los centrocampistas Dominik Szoboszlai y Ryan Gravenberch, que renovaron sus contratos a principios de este año. "Me han comunicado que el club no está en condiciones de ofrecerme un nuevo contrato, lo que, por supuesto, me entristece muchísimo", dijo a la prensa. Mac Allister decidió quedarse en Anfield tras la llegada del exentrenador del Bournemouth, Andoni Iraola, alegando que había sentido "algo especial" durante la pretemporada. Iraola señaló que aún había tiempo para negociar y subrayó que se centra en el rendimiento más que en los contratos. Mac Allister dijo que hay opciones de marcharse al final de la temporada, pero indicó que añadió que "creo que ahora mismo estoy en el club adecuado y tengo la mentalidad adecuada para dar el 100% por este club".

item.title: Report: Pelicans acquire AJ Johnson, Taj Gibson from Grizzlies
item.description: The New Orleans Pelicans acquired AJ Johnson and Taj Gibson from the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Jordan Hawkins and Micah Peavy, a future second-round draft pick and a future second-round pick swap, ESPN reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New Orleans Pelicans acquired AJ Johnson and Taj Gibson from the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Jordan Hawkins and Micah Peavy, a future second-round draft pick and a future second-round pick swap, ESPN reported on Tuesday. Johnson, 21, averaged 3.3 points and 1.1 rebounds in 48 games off the bench last season, split between the Washington Wizards and Dallas Mavericks. The well-traveled guard previously was part of the Anthony Davis blockbuster deal between Washington and Dallas last February before the Mavericks traded him to the Grizzlies in July. Johnson initially was selected by the Milwaukee Bucks with the 23rd overall pick in the 2024 NBA Draft. Gibson, 41, averaged 3.4 points and 2.7 rebounds in 10 games (one start) with Memphis last season. Hawkins, 24, contributed 5.1 points and 1.7 boards in 51 games (one start) with New Orleans last season. The UConn product was the 14th overall pick of the 2023 NBA Draft. Peavy, 25, averaged 4.3 points and 1.9 rebounds in 61 games (four starts) during his rookie season with the Pelicans in 2025-26. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bruins F Fraser Minten signs 7-year, $50.4M extension
item.description: Boston Bruins forward Fraser Minten signed a seven-year contract extension worth $50.4 million on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Boston Bruins forward Fraser Minten signed a seven-year contract extension worth $50.4 million on Tuesday. The extension spans through the 2033-34 season for Minten, who could have been a restricted free agent after this season. "We are excited to have signed Fraser to a long-term extension," Bruins general manager Don Sweeney said. "Since joining our organization, Fraser has continued to grow and earn the accelerated trust of his teammates and coaching staff. His hockey sense, competitiveness, responsible two-way game, and offensive growth make him a valuable player for our group. "This is a mutual long-term commitment that reflects our confidence in Fraser and the important role he will play, as well as Fraser's belief in our team moving forward." Minten, 22, set career highs in goals (17), assists (18) and points (35) while playing in all 82 games last season. The 6-foot-2, 204-pound forward also led all NHL rookie skaters in plus/minus (plus-21). Minten has totaled 40 points (20 goals, 20 assists) and a plus-16 rating in 107 career games with the Toronto Maple Leafs and Bruins. He was acquired by Boston from Toronto in March 2025 in a deal that included defenseman Brandon Carlo. Minten was selected by the Maple Leafs in the second round of the 2022 NHL Entry Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Marinha da Guarda Revolucionária do Irã diz ter capturado submersível não tripulado dos EUA em Ormuz
